enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Shift legs. Sigh. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to left side again. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Drying off and getting dressed in work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Dry off with towel. Apply deodorant. Put on underwear. Put on pants. Put on shirt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Look in mirror. Adjust shirt. Pick up dirty clothes. Put in hamper.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open fridge. Take out eggs and milk. Close fridge. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse plate. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing work bag, checking the day's schedule on the phone and doing final grooming
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work bag. Open bag. Put wallet in bag. Put keys in bag. Put stethoscope in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Look in mirror. Adjust hair. Adjust clothes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health facility for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to facility. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients, checking charts and administering care
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Check patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Record notes. Talk to patient. Move to next patient. Check chart. Administer injection. Record notes. Prepare for handover. Talk to colleague.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating a packed meal
enriched_activities.desc: Go to break room. Open locker. Take out packed meal. Sit at table. Open container. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Close container. Put container back in bag. Throw away trash. Wash hands. Return to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, patient rounds, documentation and handover preparation
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Enter patient room. Check vitals. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes. Move to next patient. Check chart. Administer injection. Record notes. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Prepare handover notes. Organize files. Clean equipment. Wash hands. Talk to colleague.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Put down bag. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and freshening up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Apply lotion. Put on clean clothes. Walk to kitchen.

Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables and meat. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Cook. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse plate. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food scraps into trash. Stack dishes in sink. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Dry dishes with towel. Put dishes away. Wipe counter with sponge. Spray cleaner. Wipe again. Rinse sponge. Hang towel. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Browse internet. Check email. Watch TV. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust cushion. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get water. Return to sofa. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, watching TV and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Browse internet. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Pick up phone again. Check email. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Shift legs. Sigh. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to left side again. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still.
